- [LFST.8.12] **Replayers**: still fail cleanly at stream open —
  *ruleset hash X not found; unable to replay*. Replay
  needs the rules, not merely the fact shapes, so reading
  slot values from the announcements ([LFST.8.10]) does
  not rescue it. The message **should not** say the
  payloads cannot be decoded, because they can; what is
  missing is everything else.
